requirement: The system shall allow an authorized user to create and update a seller/store profile.
planned_verification: Authorized profile create/update; deny cross-store access

requirement: The system shall allow an authorized user to add, view, update, and deactivate product records, including name, category, price, cost, variants, and stock quantity.
planned_verification: Catalogue fields and deactivation; reject invalid price/cost

requirement: The system shall allow a user to record inventory changes and configure a low-stock threshold for a product.
planned_verification: Inventory movement and configured threshold persistence

requirement: The system shall identify products at or below their configured low-stock threshold.
planned_verification: Below/equal/above threshold boundaries

requirement: The system shall allow a user to create and update orders with customer, product, quantity, delivery, discount, and status information where applicable.
planned_verification: Linked order fields and invalid quantities; atomic save

requirement: The system shall support the order statuses New, Confirmed, Processing, Shipped, and Delivered, and shall display the current status for each order.
planned_verification: Five required labels displayed; approved transition cases

requirement: The system shall maintain customer profiles and show the orders and purchase totals linked to each profile.
planned_verification: Customer linked orders and purchase totals; store isolation

requirement: The system shall calculate sales summaries for a selected time period from recorded orders.
planned_verification: Selected period aggregation matches source orders

requirement: The system shall calculate estimated profit using recorded revenue, product cost, delivery cost, discount, and other entered expenses, and identify any excluded or missing cost values.
planned_verification: Hand-calculated recorded cost breakdown; missing/excluded costs visible

requirement: The system shall display product and sales summaries through readable tables or charts.
planned_verification: Tables/charts match product and sales source records

requirement: The system shall provide an internal inbox interface where a user can enter a customer message and request a reply suggestion.
planned_verification: Entered message requests draft; empty/invalid message handling

requirement: The system shall allow the user to edit or discard an AI- generated reply suggestion; the system shall not send it automatically.
planned_verification: Draft edit/discard; no external send

requirement: The system shall allow a user to request a business summary for a selected store or time period and display the data period used.
planned_verification: Selected store/period summary exposes data period

requirement: The system shall classify customers into defined behavioral segments using available purchase data and display the rule or criteria for each segment.
planned_verification: Behavior groups show criteria; approved boundary fixtures

requirement: The system shall allow a user to request a product-demand estimate for a selected future period when sufficient historical data is available.
planned_verification: Sufficient-history product/horizon estimate

requirement: When historical data is insufficient for a forecast, the system shall state that a reliable forecast cannot be generated and may display descriptive historical sales instead.
planned_verification: Insufficient history gives explicit limitation; no numeric forecast

requirement: The system shall allow a user to configure a supported price or discount scenario for a selected product.
planned_verification: Supported product price/discount input; invalid scenario rejected

requirement: The system shall display what-if results as estimates, including the assumptions or input values used.
planned_verification: Estimate label and input/assumption disclosure

requirement: The system shall keep a record of the inputs used for an AI request sufficiently to support debugging and evaluation, while following the project’s data-retention and privacy decisions.
planned_verification: Minimized request evidence follows approved retention and access policy

requirement: The system shall distinguish AI-generated text from verified product, inventory, and calculated business values.
planned_verification: Generated text visually distinct from verified facts and calculations

requirement: For a customer-reply request, the system shall retrieve relevant product, variant, price, and stock information from the current store before generating a suggestion.
planned_verification: Current-store variant/price/stock retrieval before generation

requirement: The system shall not present a product availability or price claim as verified unless that value is present in the retrieved store data.
planned_verification: Unsupported price/availability cannot be presented as verified

requirement: The system shall generate a business insight summary from computed metrics and records for the selected time period and identify the period or metrics used.
planned_verification: Summary agrees with computed metrics and period

requirement: The system shall assign customer segments using the approved purchase-behavior features and shall not use sensitive personal attributes for segmentation.
planned_verification: Approved behavior-only features; sensitive inputs excluded

requirement: For each demand forecast, the system shall identify the product and forecast horizon and provide a numerical estimate only when the selected method’s minimum data conditions are met.
planned_verification: Minimum data gate plus product and horizon disclosure

requirement: The team shall evaluate the forecast against a simple baseline using a documented time-aware validation method when sufficient historical data is available.
planned_verification: Time-aware split and simple baseline comparison; no leakage

requirement: Profit values shall be computed from explicit recorded fields; an LLM may explain but shall not be the source of arithmetic results.
planned_verification: Exact recorded-field arithmetic independent of LLM output

requirement: The system shall label scenario results as estimates and expose the selected change and material assumptions.
planned_verification: Estimate label exposes change and material assumptions

requirement: When relevant input data is missing, inconsistent, or too limited, the system shall disclose the limitation or request additional data rather than invent a specific business fact.
planned_verification: Missing/inconsistent/limited inputs disclose gap rather than invent facts

requirement: A user shall review AI-generated customer text and scenario outputs before taking an external action.
planned_verification: Review controls before external action; no autonomous action

requirement: The system shall require authenticated access to seller data and shall enforce store-level access checks on protected application requests.
planned_verification: Unauthenticated and cross-store API denials

requirement: The system shall collect only information needed for the prototype, restrict access to customer records, and document how test data is stored and removed.
planned_verification: Minimal authorized customer data; documented storage/removal

requirement: A first-time user shall be able to complete core product and order tasks using clearly labeled forms and receive validation messages for invalid required fields.
planned_verification: First-time product/order journey and required-field feedback

requirement: For the agreed capstone test dataset and deployment environment, the team shall measure and report the response time of core record and analytics requests; no unverified response-time target is assumed at proposal stage.
planned_verification: Measure core/analytics timings on documented dataset/environment

requirement: The system shall validate required input and return a clear error message when a request fails, without silently saving incomplete or inconsistent business records.
planned_verification: Invalid input/failing request returns clear errors; no partial inconsistent save

requirement: Forecasts, profit figures, segments, and scenario outputs shall identify their relevant period, inputs, formula, or criteria in a form suitable for user review.
planned_verification: Visible period/input/formula/criteria for four numerical/group features

requirement: The application shall separate frontend, backend API, persistence, and AI/ML responsibilities so that each component can be changed and tested independently.
planned_verification: Frontend/API/persistence/AI boundaries independently inspectable/testable

requirement: The database and API design shall use normalized store-related records and pagination or filtering for lists where appropriate; performance under larger workloads will be considered future evaluation.
planned_verification: Normalized store records and appropriate list filtering/pagination

requirement: The prototype’s deployment environment and any service limitations shall be documented for the demonstration; uninterrupted production availability is outside the capstone guarantee.
planned_verification: Document demo environment, dependencies and limitations

requirement: AI text shall be presented as a suggestion, and numerical outputs shall be calculated or model-generated with disclosed limitations rather than described as guaranteed outcomes.
planned_verification: Suggestion and numeric limitation labels; no guaranteed outcomes
